topClips.title: Top Ten Clips
topClips.subtitle: Ten bite-size moments from the talks — each clip plays for 10–20 seconds.

clips.videoTitle: The Future of KERI - Samuel Smith
clips.speaker: Samuel Smith
clips.quote: I wanted to save the internet. I wanted to fix the broken internet. And I didn't realize I had to work on identity to do that.

clips.speaker: Daniel Hardman
clips.quote: Just don't answer your phone — or just stop sending texts. That's a pretty bad indictment of a technical infrastructure when the best advice we can give is just stop using it.

clips.videoTitle: State of the KERI Suite - Samuel Smith
clips.speaker: Samuel Smith
clips.quote: You thought somebody could exploit you? Wait till an AI exploits you. You thought you were being surveilled online? Just ask an AI to surveil you.

clips.videoTitle: KERI Infrastructure & the 5 W's - Thomas Mayfield
clips.speaker: Thomas Mayfield
clips.quote: If that platform shuts down, or that issuer revokes access, your identity effectively disappears with it. You are a tenant, not an owner of your digital identity.

clips.videoTitle: Digital Identity Needs a Legal Foundation - Phil Windley
clips.speaker: Phil Windley
clips.talk: Digital Identity Needs a Legal Foundation
clips.quote: These are legal rights, not terms of service. This is not a click-through contract that you don't read, where to enforce whatever small rights they've left you, you have to go to court.

clips.speaker: Kent Bull
clips.quote: They're encrypted with the key derived from the passcode you have at the edge. This passcode never moves over here — ever. That's why it's called a signing-at-the-edge architecture.

clips.speaker: Evan Asakawa
clips.quote: We wanted everything to happen in the browser — all of your keys created and stored on your device. Don't worry about them sitting on some server. We send you the app, and you get your in-browser wallet.

clips.speaker: Jared Jefferey
clips.quote: The question used to be: can we connect? The answer is yes. Now the question is: can we trust those connections?

clips.speaker: Alan Davies
clips.quote: Everybody will be their own identity provider — which is how it should be. I'm the only person who knows that I am me.

clips.videoTitle: Contract Credentials & Verifiable Identity - Cole Davis
clips.speaker: Cole Davis
clips.quote: What if the contract is the credential? What if you can hold your lease up to the smart lock — or the stock purchase agreement is the stock certificate?
